task_description: Complete replacement of Muslim Pedia app with CatatinAja - a mobile-first personal finance tracking web app (PWA) built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. Features include: transaction recording (income/expense), categories with icons, dashboard with balance summary, financial reports with Chart.js visualizations, budget management per category, data export (CSV/JSON) and import, search and filter transactions, dark mode, and full offline PWA support. All UI in Bahasa Indonesia.

verification.summary: All JavaScript files pass syntax validation (node --check). manifest.json is valid JSON. XSS prevention, offline caching, import validation, performance, and decimal handling fixes all verified present. No build system or test framework exists for this static site project - verification done via Node.js syntax checking and structural validation.
